short-bio: I am a Product Designer specializing in Design Systems and the author of Design System Beyond Layout. I currently work at Locaweb as a Senior DesignOps, where I contribute to the development of the Locaweb Design System and help foster a strong design culture across the company.
short-bio-2: I am the organizer of Detach!, a Brazilian event about design at scale, and a professor at Escåla and Alura, where I teach Design Systems, DesignOps and UX. I also offer mentoring services for designers and teams.
short-bio-3: You can find me on X, LinkedIn and GitHub.
about-1: Mateus Villain is a product designer, born in Criciúma, Santa Catarina. Graduated in Design by UniSatc, and postgraduate in Digital Product Management by FIAP, he has been working with digital products since 2016.
about-2: Currently, he is a Senior DesignOps at Locaweb, where he is responsible for the brand's design system, having worked on the restructuring of design tokens to support the multi-brand strategy, sharing the design system with KingHost, a company in the same segment as Locaweb within the LWSA group.
about-3: Besides his work at Locaweb, Mateus is a professor, having taught a series of courses, mentorships and workshops. Only at Alura, he has impacted more than 15,000 students with content such as design systems, UX, UI, accessibility, research and writing.
about-4: He is the author of the book Design System beyond the layout: Creation, strategy and governance, published by Casa do Código in 2025, which covers everything from initial planning, style and token definition, to components, microinteractions, and documentation, showing how multidisciplinary teams can work efficiently.
about-5: In addition, he is one of the organizers responsible for Detach!, the first Brazilian event about design system and design at scale, which brings together professionals from product, design and engineering to share knowledge and experiences.
about-6: Outside of these activities, Mateus works on building an open-source design system called Let's UI, a multi-brand design system focused on fluid spacing.
